AI Drive Offline: after you plug in

Built with Llama

Llama 3.2 1B Instruct Abliterated · Q4_K_M · AI Drive Offline 0.10.1-usb.4

Keep the complete Android-Drive-Kit folder on your USB drive. Android requires you to install and open the app manually. Connecting a drive does not launch it.

Open the two-page PDF · Open full text instructions

Follow these steps

  1. Install and open. In Files, open USB drive → Android-Drive-Kit → apps → AI-Drive-Offline_v0.10.1-usb.4.apk. If Android asks, allow installation from this file manager, then tap Install → Open. Already installed? Open AI Drive Offline.
  2. Connect memory. In Drive Memory, tap Choose USB memory folder. Choose USB drive → Android-Drive-Kit itself, then Use this folder → Allow. Wait for Drive connected and Verified save #. Internal storage and cloud providers are rejected.
  3. Select and load the model. Tap Choose a model, the document-plus icon, then Use External Model. Choose USB drive → Android-Drive-Kit → models → Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-abliterated.Q4_K_M.gguf. In the bottom Settings tab, use Max Context 1024 / Threads 2 / Batch 16. Dismiss the keyboard, return to Models and tap the circular play button beside the model. Wait for Model Loaded and its name; keep the drive connected.
  4. Open your chat. Go Back to Drive Memory, tap Chats → AI Bot, type in Message... and tap send. Later, use Drive Memory → Saved conversations → Continue this conversation to resume a saved chat.
  5. Finish saving before unplugging. Open Drive Memory → Save and disconnect, then confirm Save and disconnect in the dialog. Wait for saving/checking to finish. If a save error appears, keep the drive connected and resolve it. After successful disconnect, use the phone's Eject option if offered, then unplug. Next time, reconnect the same folder and load the model; another phone must grant folder access again.

Your memory and tools

Stored conversations, memories, preferences and notes use the selected USB folder. Complete history is stored separately from the smaller portion supplied to the model. Memory files are readable plaintext; protect your drive. In Drive Memory, use Offline Toolkit for the calculator and Memories to review saved entries. See the full text guide for commands, limits and recovery.

The app has no Internet permission and needs no account or subscription for the included local model.

Evidence and licenses

Read APP-VALIDATION.json for the actual checks and limits for this exact installer and selected model. Model Loaded alone does not establish a generated reply. This documentation preparation does not establish phone performance or retail readiness. Physical phone and physical USB compatibility remain untested.
